coaching.coaching: Today's 8 km was right on the MAF HR ceiling at an average of 154 bpm, which is excellent. However the 8:17 min/km pace sits just outside your target range of 7:50–8:10, and the peak HR of 167 bpm shows a brief surge beyond easy effort. Keep the cadence around 170‑175 spm and aim to stay below 155 bpm the whole run.
coaching.trend: Your recent runs show consistent aerobic heart rates under the MAF limit, but pace has varied from 7:40 to 8:36 min/km. Training load is light (14 km this week) with a modest aerobic effect, indicating room to build volume safely.
coaching.nextRun: Run 10 km at a target pace of 7:55–8:05 min/km, keep HR ≤ 154 bpm, focus on raising cadence to ~175 spm and reducing ground contact time to under 280 ms.
